title: Transformed by the Sorceress
description:
Look into the crystal, and feel your will slip away in this roleplay fantasy. A gender reversal of this scene: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mDquzEoyW88 but with a lot more... pleasure for you! You'll find me quite irresistible as I take over your mind and transform you into my obedient servant, a warlock in my service for all eternity. A mindless slave for the sorceress!

This is a roleplay file where I play a sorceress, turning you the listener into my slave, but giving you power to act in my service.

Art by Celyn.

This file has haptic feedback enabled. To set your device up, use this page .

If you don't have one, order a haptic-enabled device from Lovense with my affiliate link to help me out!
author: Mistress Calia
